player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Agodifo {player_id} wɔ agoro a ɛyɛ Reverse Tic Tac Toe mu. Wo simma no ne '{symbol}'.
Botae no ne sɛ wo bɛsiw ano adi mmiɛnsa wɔ nkan (mpɛnpii, kwansin, anaa ɛdwam). 
Sɛ wo yɛ mmiɛnsa wɔ nkan a, wo di nkoguo.
Fa wo nkrɔfoɔ no kɔma no wɔ fɔm '[4]' mu sɛdeɛ wo bɛsi wo simma no wɔ kɔm 4 mu.
Sɛ Agodifo {player_id} no, wo ne '{symbol}' na wo tamfo no ne '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nnansa a enni mu. Fa '[cell]' di dwuma.

game_action.placed: ɔkɔmhyɛni {player_id} de ne ho hyɛn ({symbol}) wɔ cell {cell}.

outcome.loss: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} sɛe no wɔ ɔkan a wadi awieɛ mu!
outcome.draw: Ɛte sɛ nea obiara adi nkogu. Obiara annyae da!
